introduction.title: Fondazione San Carlo
introduction.address: Via S. Carlo, 5, 41121 Modena MO — Italy
introduction.description1: The Fondazione San Carlo is a prestigious cultural institution in the heart of Modena. Hosted in a baroque palace designed by Bartolomeo Avanzini and completed in 1764, the venue features an elegant portico of 32 red Verona marble columns stretching along Via Emilia and Corso Canal Grande.
introduction.description2: The interior offers refined, functional spaces ideal for events, workshops and conferences. The San Carlo Church, on the ground floor, seats up to 400 people and is equipped with an audio-video system and barrier-free access.
introduction.description3: The Fondazione is a perfect setting for learning, socialising and culture, combining history and innovation in an easily accessible venue with all the services you need.
